Tenure as the union of contract intervals, in a database

dot-tenure_days_db.Rd

The database version of .tenure_days(), as dplyr verbs that dbplyr turns into SQL. The latest end among the key's earlier contracts is a window function, MAX(end) OVER (PARTITION BY keys ORDER BY start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), and days are differences of dates (DATE - DATE, a number of days in DuckDB and PostgreSQL). Contracts with the same start add up to their latest end whatever order the window puts them in, so the result matches .tenure_days().

Usage

.tenure_days_db(
  contracts,
  keys,
  ref,
  start_date_col,
  end_date_col,
  contract_type_col
)

Arguments

contracts

A lazy table of contracts.

keys

Character vector. The columns to compute tenure by.

ref

The reference date, as an expression for mutate(): a column symbol (a panel's snapshot date) or a SQL date literal.

start_date_col, end_date_col, contract_type_col

Character. The contract start date, end date and type columns.

Value

A lazy table with keys, tenure_days and tenure_years.
